import numpy as np

# Load original run (r5) and ablated run (r8)
# r5 has 6 inputs, r8 has 3 inputs (same first 3)
r5 = np.load('/work/fwd/r5/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)
r8 = np.load('/work/fwd/r8/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)

mlp_orig = r5['L0_MLP'][:3]  # first 3 inputs from r5
mlp_abl = r8['L0_MLP']       # all 3 inputs from r8 (L0H0 zeroed)

print("L0_MLP write - original vs L0H0_ablated:")
print("Max absolute diff:", np.max(np.abs(mlp_orig - mlp_abl)))
print("Mean absolute diff:", np.mean(np.abs(mlp_orig - mlp_abl)))

# Check by position for input 0
print("\nInput 0, L0_MLP write per position (orig vs abl):")
for pos in range(1, 9):
    diff = np.abs(mlp_orig[0,pos] - mlp_abl[0,pos])
    print(f"  Pos {pos}: max_diff={np.max(diff):.4f}, mean_diff={np.mean(diff):.4f}")

print("\nConclusion: L0_MLP depends on L0H0_ATTN? (large diff = yes)")

print("\nConclusion: L0_MLP varies with its own position token even with L0H0 ablated")
